author: CC
prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-12: first measurement of a non-Linux box's install. On akiendell the installer's dry-run check (python -m cairn.devices.recovery.machines.installer.installer --dry-run --check) lists usage-widget-hook as OFFERED. gather_host_seams returns exactly one seam, usage-widget-hook, a KDE plasmoid fed by a Stop hook; its verify is `jq -r .updatedAt ~/.claude/usage-cache.json` and run_verify answers (False, 'jq: command not found') because this Windows box has no jq and no ~/.claude/usage-cache.json. install() has no platform notion, so any seam whose verify fails is offered, and the install gate (installed()) refuses while one lack stands: a Windows box can never read installed.
